title: Promega MagneSil Nucleic Acid Purification Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: User is alerted to check for elution plate.

steps.title: Add Resuspension Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 90 µL Resuspension Buffer to each column of the sample plate.

steps.title: Add Lysis Solution
steps.instruction: Add 120 µL Lysis Solution to each column of the sample plate.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 2 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Add Neutralization Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 120 µL Neutralization Buffer to each column of the sample plate.

steps.title: Add MagneSil Blue
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL MagneSil Blue to each column of the sample plate.

steps.title: Bind DNA to beads
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to even columns
steps.instruction: Transfer 250 µL of the lysate from each original column to the corresponding even‑numbered column in the same plate.

steps.title: Add MagneSil Red
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL MagneSil Red to each column of the sample plate.

steps.title: Bind with MagneSil Red
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Discard waste
steps.instruction: Discard 300 µL from each column into the matching wells of a 12‑well reservoir for liquid waste.

steps.title: Ethanol wash (3×)
steps.instruction: Perform three consecutive ethanol washes: add 100 µL ethanol to each column, engage magnets and incubate 2 minutes, discard 100 µL into the 12‑well reservoir, disengage magnets. After the third wash, dry the beads for 10 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL ethanol to each column.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: After the final wash, keep the plate on the magnetic module for 10 minutes to allow residual ethanol to evaporate.

steps.title: Prepare elution plate
steps.instruction: Alert the user to check the elution plate, then add 100 µL Elution Buffer to each column.

steps.title: Elution incubation
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of eluate from each column to the corresponding well of the elution plate.
